lines.zh: 我的腿还记得去集市的那条路。
lines.en: My legs still remember the road to the market.

lines.zh: 一步一晃，肩膀上的菌在摇。
lines.en: Each step sways the fungus riding on my shoulders.

lines.zh: 我走得歪，可门轴一响就到了。
lines.en: I walk crooked, but a hinge creak brings me there.

lines.zh: 村里的小径，闭着眼也认得。
lines.en: These village paths I know with my eyes shut.

lines.zh: 木门挡不住我，我学过怎么推。
lines.en: Wooden doors stop nothing; I learned how to push.

lines.zh: 脚底的泥，还是昨晚那户人家的。
lines.en: The mud on my feet came from last night's house.

lines.zh: 我拖着一条手臂，另一条在找门。
lines.en: One arm drags; the other is hunting for a door.

lines.zh: 走廊太窄，我的肩膀老是蹭墙。
lines.en: The hall is narrow; my shoulder keeps scraping walls.

lines.zh: 从田埂到床边，我用了一整夜。
lines.en: From the field ridge to your bed took all night.

lines.zh: 走路时菌丝在地上拖出白线。
lines.en: As I walk, mycelium drags white lines on the floor.

lines.zh: 我绕开了狗，狗先绕开了我。
lines.en: I stepped around the dog; the dog went first.

lines.zh: 这双脚以前穿着草鞋，现在不用了。
lines.en: These feet once wore straw sandals; not anymore.

lines.zh: 我沿着屋檐走，这样影子更短。
lines.en: I walk along the eaves so my shadow stays short.

lines.zh: 每扇门后，我都停半息听一下。
lines.en: Behind each door I pause half a breath to listen.

lines.zh: 我数着墙上的钉子，一共七颗。
lines.en: I count the nails in the wall; there are seven.

lines.zh: 手指头还记得怎么数铜板。
lines.en: My fingers still remember counting copper coins.

lines.zh: 站在院子里，等谁先把灯点上。
lines.en: I stand in the yard, waiting for someone to light a lamp.

lines.zh: 菌在我喉咙里长，说话像漏风。
lines.en: Fungus grows in my throat; my voice leaks air.

lines.zh: 肩膀上那块，原来是围裙的结。
lines.en: That lump on my shoulder was once an apron knot.

lines.zh: 我发呆的时候，手还在扫地。
lines.en: Even while I stare, my hand keeps sweeping.

lines.zh: 钟楼响过两次，我还没动。
lines.en: The bell has rung twice; I have not moved.

lines.zh: 我记得该去喂鸡，可鸡都跑了。
lines.en: I remember feeding chickens, but the chickens fled.

lines.zh: 屋里很静，静得能听见菌长。
lines.en: The house is quiet enough to hear fungus growing.

lines.zh: 我蹲在门槛上，像在等收工。
lines.en: I crouch on the threshold like a man off shift.

lines.zh: 阳光照进来，我的影子不太对。
lines.en: Sunlight comes in; my shadow does not look right.

lines.zh: 手上的动作，是多年养成的。
lines.en: The motions of my hands come from many years.

lines.zh: 我把歪掉的袖口理了一下。
lines.en: I straighten the crooked cuff of my sleeve.

lines.zh: 谁家晚饭的味道，飘到我这边了。
lines.en: Someone's dinner smell has drifted over to me.

lines.zh: 你的脸，像我以前见过的某个人。
lines.en: Your face looks like someone I once knew.

lines.zh: 别动，让我看看你的眼睛。
lines.en: Hold still and let me look at your eyes.

lines.zh: 你手里拿的是铁，不是货。
lines.en: What you hold is iron, not goods to trade.

lines.zh: 我记得该说欢迎，可嘴不合。
lines.en: I remember greeting you, but my mouth will not close.

lines.zh: 你看我的时候，退得比看得快。
lines.en: You back away faster than you look at me.

lines.zh: 门是你关的？我听见了插销。
lines.en: Did you shut that door? I heard the bolt.

lines.zh: 再靠近一格，你就进我手里了。
lines.en: One more block and you are in my hands.

lines.zh: 你的靴子干净，说明刚出门。
lines.en: Your boots are clean; you just stepped outside.

lines.zh: 我在你脸上找害怕，找到了。
lines.en: I search your face for fear and I find it.

lines.zh: 别挥手，我看不懂客气了。
lines.en: Do not wave; I no longer understand politeness.

lines.zh: 你站的位置，正好一扇门的宽。
lines.en: Where you stand is exactly one doorway wide.

lines.zh: 我盯着你，是因为你会动。
lines.en: I stare at you because you are the one moving.

lines.zh: 你这身衣服，村里也有人穿。
lines.en: Someone in the village wore clothes like yours.

lines.zh: 眼睛借我用一下，就一下。
lines.en: Lend me your eyes, just for a moment.

lines.zh: 你的手里没有货，我就不客气。
lines.en: You carry no goods, so I need not be polite.

lines.zh: 你身上的味道，像那间铁匠铺。
lines.en: You smell like that blacksmith's shop.

lines.zh: 两格厚的皮，你砍得动吗？
lines.en: Armor two thick: can your blade get through?

lines.zh: 疼，我记得这种疼，是人的疼。
lines.en: It hurts; I remember this pain, a human pain.

lines.zh: 三十五点生命，不多，够用。
lines.en: Thirty-five health: not much, but enough.

lines.zh: 你打在我肩上，菌掉了一块。
lines.en: You hit my shoulder and a clump of fungus drops.

lines.zh: 我退了一步，手还在往前伸。
lines.en: I step back, but my hand keeps reaching forward.

lines.zh: 别以为我会倒，我早就不是人了。
lines.en: Do not think I fall; I stopped being human long ago.

lines.zh: 伤口里爬出来的东西，替我缝合。
lines.en: What crawls from my wound stitches me back up.

lines.zh: 这一下让我想起被石头砸的那年。
lines.en: This blow recalls the year a stone hit me.

lines.zh: 你砍中的地方，本来就是空的。
lines.en: Where you struck was hollow to begin with.

lines.zh: 我抖了一下，不是怕，是疼。
lines.en: I twitch, not from fear, but from pain.

lines.zh: 面包的味道，我快想不起来了。
lines.en: The smell of bread is something I barely recall.

lines.zh: 你举着苹果，像在跟老朋友谈价。
lines.en: Holding out an apple, you haggle like an old friend.

lines.zh: 我饿，但我不想吃你给的东西。
lines.en: I am hungry, but I do not want your offering.

lines.zh: 交易早停了，铺子也没了。
lines.en: Trading ended long ago; the stall is gone.

lines.zh: 甜味钻进菌丝，反而更痒。
lines.en: Sweetness crawls into my mycelium and itches worse.

lines.zh: 你把手伸那么远，是怕我咬吗？
lines.en: You hold it far out; afraid I might bite?

lines.zh: 我喉咙里长的东西，咽不下麦子。
lines.en: What grows in my throat cannot swallow wheat.

lines.zh: 拿开，我想起自己曾经很客气。
lines.en: Take it away; I remember being polite once.

lines.zh: 你要是给我一把刀，我可能会接。
lines.en: Offer me a knife instead, and I might take it.

lines.zh: 食物留着自己吃，路还长。
lines.en: Keep the food for yourself; the road is long.

lines.zh: 撞我一下，你身上就多个印子。
lines.en: Bump me once and you carry a new mark.

lines.zh: 别贴太近，我一格半就够到。
lines.en: Not so close; one and a half blocks is my reach.

lines.zh: 你挤过来，我的手自己抬了。
lines.en: You push in, and my hand lifts on its own.

lines.zh: 这肩膀撞过门，也撞过人。
lines.en: This shoulder has hit doors and hit people.

lines.zh: 退开，我走路不太会拐弯。
lines.en: Step aside; I am not good at turning.

lines.zh: 撞上我，等于把脖子递过来。
lines.en: Bumping me is handing over your neck.

lines.zh: 我不疼，我只觉得你挡路。
lines.en: It does not hurt; you are simply in my way.

lines.zh: 别在我面前晃，手会记得。
lines.en: Stop swaying in front of me; my hand remembers.

lines.zh: 你的肩撞我，我的肩不收。
lines.en: Your shoulder hits mine, and mine does not yield.

lines.zh: 再撞一次，我就当你请我进门。
lines.en: Bump me again and I hear a welcome through the door.

lines.zh: 我记得有个家，门口有两只鞋。
lines.en: I remember a home with two pairs of shoes at the door.

lines.zh: 现在只剩菌丝，替我接着长。
lines.en: Now only mycelium remains, growing in my place.

lines.zh: 那种事，我记不清了。
lines.en: That sort of thing, I no longer recall clearly.

lines.zh: 我连自己的名字都念不顺。
lines.en: I cannot even say my own name straight.

lines.zh: 别靠太近，我身上的菌会爬。
lines.en: Do not come close; the fungus on me crawls.

lines.zh: 你想要的温柔，我早弄丢了。
lines.en: The tenderness you want, I lost long ago.

lines.zh: 同类抱一下，只会黏在一起。
lines.en: Two of my kind embrace and simply stick together.

lines.zh: 我以前会给谁留一盏灯。
lines.en: I used to leave a lamp burning for someone.

lines.zh: 家里那扇窗，我修过三回。
lines.en: I repaired that window at home three times.

lines.zh: 别提这个，我手上的动作会乱。
lines.en: Do not bring it up; my hands start moving wrong.

lines.zh: 地上那把镰刀，我捡得很快。
lines.en: That sickle on the ground, I pick it up fast.

lines.zh: 这枚铜板，我留着当个念想。
lines.en: I keep this copper coin as a small remembrance.

lines.zh: 你掉的钥匙，我先替你拿着。
lines.en: The key you dropped, I will hold it for now.

lines.zh: 拾东西的手，比走路的手稳。
lines.en: The hand that picks things is steadier than my walk.

lines.zh: 这根木棍，握起来像把扫帚。
lines.en: This stick feels like a broom in my grip.

lines.zh: 我弯腰捡起面包，又放下了。
lines.en: I bend, pick up the bread, and set it down.

lines.zh: 有用的带走，没用的踢开。
lines.en: Useful things I take; the rest I kick aside.

lines.zh: 那顶草帽，我戴不上了。
lines.en: That straw hat no longer fits my head.

lines.zh: 捡到布头，我会往袖口比一比。
lines.en: When I find cloth scraps, I measure them against my cuff.

lines.zh: 别抢我手里的，我抓得紧。
lines.en: Do not grab what is in my hands; I hold tight.

lines.zh: 你出门的声音，我听见了。
lines.en: I heard the sound of you stepping outside.

lines.zh: 目标就是你，先别锁门。
lines.en: The target is you; do not bolt the door yet.

lines.zh: 我认得这条路的尽头是谁家。
lines.en: I know whose house sits at the end of this path.

lines.zh: 有人在屋里走动，我去看看。
lines.en: Someone is moving indoors; I will go and look.

lines.zh: 你跑吧，我认识每一条巷子。
lines.en: Run if you like; I know every alley here.

lines.zh: 一扇门，一块田，我顺着找。
lines.en: One door, one field; I follow the trail.

lines.zh: 听见了吗，我的脚步在门口停了。
lines.en: Hear that? My footsteps stop at your door.

lines.zh: 别躲床底，那地方我熟。
lines.en: Do not hide under the bed; I know that place.

lines.zh: 你身上的味道，刚从灶边过来。
lines.en: You smell like you just left the stove.

lines.zh: 灯亮着，说明你还没睡。
lines.en: The lamp is lit, so you are still awake.

lines.zh: 我把门推开一条缝，看你。
lines.en: I push the door open a crack and watch you.

lines.zh: 你退到墙角，我走得更慢。
lines.en: You back into the corner; I walk slower.

lines.zh: 手抬起来了，这次不扫空。
lines.en: My hand is up, and this sweep will not miss.

lines.zh: 一步，两步，你数得清吗？
lines.en: One step, two steps; can you keep count?

lines.zh: 我绕着桌子走，你绕着桌子退。
lines.en: I circle the table; you circle it backward.

lines.zh: 别关门，我听得见插销。
lines.en: Do not shut it; I can hear the bolt slide.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西，挡不住横扫。
lines.en: Whatever you hold will not stop a wide sweep.

lines.zh: 我停一下，是想让你以为安全。
lines.en: I pause so you will think you are safe.

lines.zh: 屋里的空间小，你躲不开。
lines.en: The room is small; there is nowhere to dodge.

lines.zh: 再退半步，你就贴墙了。
lines.en: Half a step more and your back meets the wall.

lines.zh: 一巴掌扫过来，带起一片菌尘。
lines.en: One wide slap comes with a cloud of fungal dust.

lines.zh: 十点伤害，够你记住这个屋子。
lines.en: Ten points of damage will make you remember this room.

lines.zh: 我的手抓住你，往我这边拖。
lines.en: My hand catches you and drags you my way.

lines.zh: 别退，我一格半就够到。
lines.en: Do not pull back; one and a half blocks is enough.

lines.zh: 这一扫，把桌上的碗都打翻了。
lines.en: This sweep knocks every bowl off the table.

lines.zh: 你抬手挡了，我的另一只手还在。
lines.en: You raise one arm to block; my other hand is still free.

lines.zh: 我拉你过来，只是想看清脸。
lines.en: I pull you close only to see your face.

lines.zh: 手臂扫过的风，比刀刃还凉。
lines.en: The wind of my arm is colder than a blade.

lines.zh: 你摔倒了，我的手也跟着落下。
lines.en: You fall, and my hand falls right after.

lines.zh: 别叫，这屋子隔音不好。
lines.en: Do not shout; this house has thin walls.

lines.zh: 我从村口那间屋子走出来了。
lines.en: I have walked out of that house by the village gate.

lines.zh: 昨天的我还懂得打招呼。
lines.en: Yesterday I still knew how to say hello.

lines.zh: 菌把我从里往外撑开了一寸。
lines.en: The fungus pushed me open an inch from inside.

lines.zh: 新长的手，还不太听使唤。
lines.en: This new-grown hand does not quite obey me.

lines.zh: 我醒来时，围裙还系在身上。
lines.en: When I woke, the apron was still tied on.

lines.zh: 门是我自己推开的，记得吗？
lines.en: I pushed that door open myself; remember?

lines.zh: 这片田，我种过，也踩过。
lines.en: I have planted this field, and trampled it.

lines.zh: 村子安静得只剩我的呼吸。
lines.en: The village is so quiet only my breathing remains.

lines.zh: 我试着说话，出来的是菌丝。
lines.en: I try to speak, and mycelium comes out instead.

lines.zh: 别急着跑，先让我认认路。
lines.en: Do not rush off; let me learn the roads first.

lines.zh: 火顺着菌丝烧，我整条手臂都亮了。
lines.en: Fire runs along my mycelium; my whole arm glows.

lines.zh: 从屋顶摔下来，膝盖先着地。
lines.en: I fall from the roof and my knees land first.

lines.zh: 水灌进喉咙，菌丝浮了一层。
lines.en: Water fills my throat and mycelium floats up.

lines.zh: 炸开的气浪，把我推回门里。
lines.en: The blast wave throws me back through the door.

lines.zh: 箭钉在我背上，像根多余的钉子。
lines.en: An arrow pins my back like an extra nail.

lines.zh: 那股力道让我想起被谁按住过。
lines.en: That force reminds me of being held down once.

lines.zh: 饿得手指发抖，菌丝先咬我。
lines.en: Hunger shakes my fingers; the mycelium bites me first.

lines.zh: 雷打在屋脊，我跟着抖了一下。
lines.en: Lightning hits the roof ridge and I flinch with it.

lines.zh: 脚下空了，我还在往下掉。
lines.en: The ground is gone and I am still falling.
